$comment: How many MAJOR versions ahead of npm the published Rust crates run. This five-key object is release metadata: preserve `$comment` and the historical `reason`; for each new Rust-only major increment `majorOffset` by exactly one, replace `latestBreak` with the new non-empty break account, and append its issue/PR entries to `refs` without removing or reordering existing refs. scripts/sync-versions.js applies the offset; scripts/check-rust-major-offset.mjs validates it. See docs/contributing/release.md.
reason: Rust-only break #2: carrying the representation-item id on GPU-instanced occurrences (#2985) adds a public field to four structs that are exhaustively constructible through the public API, so any downstream struct literal stops compiling. Measured with cargo-semver-checks against the published 7.1.1, --release-type minor: ifc-lite-geometry 196 checks, 195 pass, 1 fail, 58 skip (InstanceMeshRef::item_id, DecodedInstance::item_id); ifc-lite-processing the same verdict (InstanceRecord::geometry_item_id, RawInstanceOccurrence::geometry_item_id). Both report "semver requires new major version: 1 major and 0 minor checks failed" on constructible_struct_adds_field. None of the four is #[non_exhaustive], and adding that attribute would itself be breaking, so the feature cannot ship without a major. The npm packages carry only a minor, and a changeset written about the TypeScript API cannot express a Rust break. The previous offset of 1 is retained in history: this raises it rather than replacing it, because the offset is cumulative against the npm major. Rust-only break #2 also covers `ifc-lite-export`, which acquired four constructible-struct fields in the same unpublished cycle: `StepStats.refused_refs`, `MergedOptions.drop_empty_containers`, `MergedStats.dropped_container_count` and `GltfStats.unverified_instance_groups` (#3666). Re-measured with cargo-semver-checks 0.50.0 against the published 7.1.1, --release-type minor: 196 checks, 195 pass, 1 fail, 58 skip, the one failure being constructible_struct_adds_field naming all four, and "semver requires new major version". None of the four structs is #[non_exhaustive] and the repo's precedent for RESULT/stats structs is a plain struct (only the OPTIONS structs `GltfOptions` and `ModelOptions` carry the attribute), so adding it would itself be a break rather than the way this is recorded. The offset is NOT raised again: it went to 2 on 2026-08-30, after the last publish tag, so the 8.x major it implies is still pending and these fields ride it. This entry is the record of what else that major covers. Rust-only break #3: BoolFailureReason gains variants on an enum that is re-exported from the crate root and is NOT #[non_exhaustive], so any downstream exhaustive match stops compiling. Measured with cargo-semver-checks against the published crate, --release-type minor, on ifc-lite-geometry: "semver requires new major version: 3 major and 0 minor checks failed". The three are enum_variant_added on BoolFailureReason::OpenTopologyRejected (added by #3717) and on BoolFailureReason::NonManifoldRejected (added by #3440 step 3), plus function_parameter_count_changed on aggregate_diagnostics, which went from 5 to 6 parameters in #3766. Only the second is new here: the other two are already on main and were never recorded, so the release lane was blocked before this change and one offset bump covers all three - they are all in the same unpublished window, which is why cargo-semver-checks still sees them against the registry. Adding #[non_exhaustive] to BoolFailureReason would itself be breaking, so the variants cannot ship without a major. The npm packages carry only a patch, and a changeset written about the TypeScript API cannot express a Rust break. Raises the previous offset of 2 rather than replacing it: the offset is cumulative against the npm major. Rust-only break #4: TWO constructible-struct field additions landed after the 9.4.0 publish (npm 6.4.0 + offset 3), so unlike breaks #2 and #3 they do NOT ride a pending major: the major implied by offset 3 is published. Measured with cargo-semver-checks 0.50.0 against the published 9.4.0, on main at 92e590337: ifc-lite-geometry fails constructible_struct_adds_field on Mesh.welded_in_object_frame (rust/geometry/src/mesh.rs:70, added by #4182 for #4122's welded-in-object-frame bit), and ifc-lite-export fails the same lint on StepStats.attribute_edits_refused (rust/export/src/step_api.rs:130, added by #4213 for #4125's by-index split validation). Both report "semver requires new major version: 1 major and 0 minor checks failed". Raising the offset rather than reverting both fields: each is load-bearing telemetry for the fix that added it, and #4193 has already shown what reverting costs (OpeningDiagnostic lost triangle_count purely to keep 9.4.1 a patch, and the classifier's own diagnostic can no longer explain its kind). Rust-only break #5: the appearance slices merged after the 11.0.0 publish (npm 7.0.0 + offset 4) break ifc-lite-processing's public API and do NOT ride a pending major. Measured with cargo-semver-checks 0.50.0 against the published 11.0.0, on main at 7aeca8e6d: "semver requires new major version: 5 major and 0 minor checks failed". (1) struct_missing: pdf_vector::PdfVectorDiagnostic removed and (2) struct_pub_field_missing: PreparedPdfVectorPage lost state_qualified, geometry_ready, pending_geometry and diagnostics, both replaced by the page-level FidelityReport (#4547 for #4406); (3) enum_variant_added: PdfVectorOperator, re-exported and not #[non_exhaustive], gained 16 diagnosed-operator variants (Clip, TextClip, Text, Image, Shading, FillPattern, StrokePattern, GraphicsState, GroupBegin/End, FormBegin/End, AnnotationBegin/End, MarkedContent, EndMarkedContent) and (4) enum_no_repr_variant_discriminant_changed: PdfVectorOperator::Unsupported moved 11 -> 27 (#4547); (5) constructible_struct_adds_field on plain request/plan structs: AppearanceRequest.face_masks and AppearanceConversion.{surface_fingerprint, masked_triangles, retained_geometry_item_id} (#4545 for #4404), MeshTransferRequest.max_behind_metres and TransferCoverage.unknown_behind_samples (#4539 for #4381), PdfFillAnnotationRequest.{property_set_global_id, property_relation_global_id, accepted_fidelity_sha256}, PdfFillAnnotationPlan.{property_set_id, fidelity}, PreparedPdfVectorPage.fidelity (#4547). The removals are deliberate supersessions (AGENTS.md anti-cruft: the state-qualified page shape is replaced, not kept beside the report), so the break cannot be made additive; the version-packages PR #4537 carried 11.0.0 -> 11.1.0 and the Rust crate semver gate refused it. Raises the offset from 4 rather than replacing it: the offset is cumulative against the npm major. Also riding the pending 12.0.0 major, recorded here rather than raising the offset again: ifc-lite-core removed `EntityDecoder::get_polyloop_coords_fast` (inherent_method_missing against the published 11.0.0). It had no caller in the workspace, in `packages/`, or in the wasm bindings; it handed back a polygon one corner shorter than the file when a point ref did not resolve; and its guarded sibling `get_polyloop_coords_cached` is the live accessor. Supersede means delete (AGENTS.md anti-cruft), and fixing a fn with no consumer in place would have kept a semver liability alive. Also riding the pending 12.0.0 major, recorded here rather than raising the offset again: ifc-lite-export removed the infallible `export_collada_from_meshes` and `export_kmz_collada_from_meshes` (function_missing against the published 11.0.0). Their only production caller, the wasm KMZ binding, moved to the fail-closed `try_` twins, and an infallible path that ships a schema-invalid COLLADA document as success is exactly what those twins exist to close, so leaving it reachable for an external caller would re-open it (AGENTS.md anti-cruft: supersede means delete). Also riding the pending 12.0.0 major, recorded here rather than raising the offset again: ifc-lite-geometry's BoolFailureReason (re-exported, not #[non_exhaustive]) gains OperandBudgetExhausted, the record for the boolean operand walk's new per-element visit budget (enum_variant_added against the published 11.0.0, the same lint break #3 recorded for this enum). Adding #[non_exhaustive] would itself be breaking, so the variant rides the major the crates are already ahead by. Also riding the pending 12.0.0 major: ifc-lite-core adds three fields to the constructible GeoReference (constructible_struct_adds_field on GeoReference.factor_x, factor_y and factor_z, the IfcMapConversionScaled per-axis factors that nothing read), and ModelBounds::has_large_coordinates and ModelBounds::rtc_offset each take the length unit scale (method_parameter_count_changed), because the 10 km gate compared file-unit values against a metre threshold. It also adds GeoReference.has_map_conversion (constructible_struct_adds_field), so presence is a fact of the parsed record rather than re-derived from values that a rotation-only conversion leaves at zero. Riding the pending 14.0.0 major (npm 9.0.0 from the `@ifc-lite/wasm` major in #4644, + offset 5), recorded here rather than raising the offset: ifc-lite-geometry changes the return types of `ClippingProcessor::subtract_mesh_many` (`Result<Mesh>` to the new `GroupCut`), `kernel::mesh_bridge::subtract_many` (`Option<Mesh>` to `BatchSubtract`), `kernel::arrangement::difference_all` and `difference_all_lenient` (each now also returns the classifier's changed bit), `projection_outline::mesh_outline_2d` (`Option<MeshOutline>` to `Result<MeshOutline, NoOutline>`) and `zone_split::split_mesh_by_zones` (`ZoneSplit` to `Option<ZoneSplit>`), so a rejected group cut, a host without volume and an over-budget outline are their own outcomes instead of a result that looks like success. Not measured with cargo-semver-checks; any downstream caller of these functions stops compiling. Also riding the pending 14.0.0 major brought by the `@ifc-lite/wasm` major in #4644 (#4635): three ifc-lite-core removals that each delete the second copy of a lexical rule (one rule, one home): `EntityScanner::has_non_null_attribute` (inherent_method_missing), superseded by `nth_attribute_is_present`, now the single comment-aware attribute read and re-exported from the crate root as before; `IfcSchema::has_geometry` (inherent_method_missing), a leaf-level whitelist that disagreed with `has_geometry_by_name` on `IfcChiller` and had no caller outside an example; and `encode_ifc_string` (function_missing at the crate root), a second STEP string encoder whose own doc said not to write its output into a literal, with no caller; the writer is `ifc_lite_export::escape_step_string`. Supersede means delete (AGENTS.md anti-cruft). Also riding the pending 14.0.0 major brought by the `@ifc-lite/wasm` major in #4644 (#4611, #4643): ifc-lite-core removed RtcOffset and ModelBounds::rtc_offset now returns Option<RtcVerdict> (new enum in ifc_lite_core::limits) so a scan with no points is distinct from a small model and a large extent keeps its needs-shift verdict even when its centre is inside 10 km; ifc-lite-geometry GeometryRouter::detect_rtc_offset_with_fallback returns Option<RtcVerdict> for the same reasons; ifc-lite-processing uses one MeshFrame selector and one MeshCoordinateSpace tag; ifc-lite-wasm removed the dead post-f32 MeshCollection::apply_rtc_offset repair. Also riding the pending 14.0.0 major brought by the `@ifc-lite/wasm` major in #4644 (#4614, #4642): ifc-lite-wasm changed IfcAPI::set_entity_index to return Result so rejected column sets surface failure instead of retaining stale state. Also riding the pending 14.0.0 major, recorded here rather than raising the offset again: ifc-lite-processing::Georeferencing gains the public factor_x, factor_y and factor_z fields required to serialize IfcMapConversionScaled without making clients reverse-engineer transform_matrix (#4615). The struct is publicly constructible and not #[non_exhaustive], so this is constructible_struct_adds_field against the published 13.0.1 API (read from the struct, not measured with cargo-semver-checks). Also riding the pending 14.0.0 major, recorded here rather than raising the offset again: ifc-lite-geometry changes the return type of `ClippingProcessor::subtract_mesh` from `Result<Mesh>` to the `GroupCut` that `subtract_mesh_many` already returns (#4692), so a rejected single-cutter subtract and a cutter that never reaches the host are their own outcomes instead of the host handed back in the shape of a cut. `GroupCut` also gains the `Retessellated(Mesh)` variant (enum_variant_added; the enum is re-exported and not #[non_exhaustive], so an exhaustive downstream match stops compiling), which `subtract_mesh` returns for a cutter the kernel classifies as not reaching the host. Not measured with cargo-semver-checks; any downstream caller of `subtract_mesh` stops compiling. Also riding the pending 14.0.0 major, recorded here rather than raising the offset again: ifc-lite-export removed the fail-open from-bytes GLB entry points `export_glb`, `export_glb_with_stats`, `export_glb_streaming_bounded` and `export_glb_streaming_bounded_with_index` (function_missing), and renamed `export_glb_with_stats_with_index` to `try_export_glb_with_stats_with_index`, which now returns `Result` (#4685). Each returned a zero-mesh GLB as success on an empty visible set, and that GLB is not valid glTF; each removed function has a `try_` twin that refuses it with `ExportError::NoRenderGeometry`, and no caller in the workspace, in `packages/` or in the wasm bindings used the removed ones outside tests and one example. Supersede means delete (AGENTS.md anti-cruft), the same call made for `export_collada_from_meshes` above. Read from the removed signatures, not measured with cargo-semver-checks. Rust-only break #6: the 14.0.0 crates are PUBLISHED (crates.io reports max_version 14.0.0 for all seven published crates: ifc-lite-core, -clash, -geometry, -processing, -export, -ffi and -wasm; npm `@ifc-lite/wasm` 9.0.0 + offset 5), so the three breaks below do NOT ride a pending major the way #2 and #3 did. Measured with cargo-semver-checks 0.50.0 on a tree that merges the heads of #4749, #4750 and #4752 onto main at 6fa3d1425, `--baseline-version 14.0.0 --release-type minor` so the baseline is the registry crate and the run discriminates rather than skipping; the cited file:line are on those PR branches, not on main. ifc-lite-processing: 196 checks, 193 pass, 3 fail, 58 skip, "semver requires new major version: 3 major and 0 minor checks failed". The three are constructible_struct_adds_field on ProcessingResult.frame (rust/processing/src/processor/mod.rs:134), enum_struct_variant_field_added on the `placement` field of MeshFrame::SiteLocal (rust/processing/src/mesh_frame.rs:92) and enum_struct_variant_field_missing on that variant's `translation` field, which the whole site placement replaces; all three come from #4749 for #4706, which hands the symbolic extractor the frame the meshes beside it were baked in. ifc-lite-export: 196 checks, 195 pass, 1 fail, 58 skip, "semver requires new major version: 1 major and 0 minor checks failed", constructible_struct_adds_field on StepStats.required_slots_unfilled (rust/export/src/step_api.rs:147), added by #4750 for #4714. ifc-lite-geometry: 196 checks, 195 pass, 1 fail, 58 skip, the same verdict line, inherent_method_missing on GeometryRouter::detect_rtc_offset_from_first_element, which the published crate carries at src/router/rtc_offset.rs:377. #4752 for #4611 removes it because `detect_rtc_offset_for_file(content, decoder)` is the whole-file entry point that supersedes it, taking the same content-only arguments and returning the RtcVerdict; the sibling `detect_rtc_offset_with_fallback` is NOT the replacement, it takes a job list a whole-file caller does not have. Supersede means delete (AGENTS.md anti-cruft). The other four published crates are clean on the same tree, each 196 checks, 196 pass, 58 skip, "no semver update required": ifc-lite-core, ifc-lite-clash, ifc-lite-ffi and ifc-lite-wasm. ifc-lite-ffi is measured because scripts/lib/crates-io.mjs publishes SEVEN crates, not six, and a six-crate run would have left one of them unexamined while claiming the set. The same command run on main alone at 6fa3d1425 reports "no semver update required" for all seven, so nothing merged after the 14.0.0 publish is an unrecorded break and each of the breaks above is introduced by its own PR rather than inherited. That control is a signature comparison, so it does not speak for the 58 lints cargo-semver-checks skips per crate behind non-default features, nor for a behavioural break under an unchanged signature. None of StepStats, ProcessingResult or MeshFrame is #[non_exhaustive], and adding the attribute would itself be breaking, so none of them can be made additive; the changesets on all three PRs are `patch`, and a changeset written about the TypeScript API cannot express a Rust break. #4749 changes three further public things, triaged by READING the signatures rather than by the tool. One is a real break the tool does not report: `MeshFrame::select` changes a public parameter type, `Option<(f64, f64, f64)>` to `Option<&[f64]>` (rust/processing/src/mesh_frame.rs:64 on main, :117 on the branch), so every downstream caller stops compiling, and cargo-semver-checks reports NOTHING for it because no default lint covers a type-only signature change with the arity unchanged. That is precisely why it is written here: the measured count of 3 for ifc-lite-processing is the tool's count, not the count of breaks. The other two are not breaks: `symbolic::rebase::RenderFrameRebase` gains fields but is `pub(super)` with private fields (rust/processing/src/symbolic/rebase.rs:33) and fires no lint, and the new `extract_symbolic_data_with_provenance_in_frame` and `MeshFrame::rotate_into_frame` are additions, which are minor. Raises the offset from 5 rather than replacing it: the offset is cumulative against the npm major, so the crates publish at 15.0.0 while the npm packages stay on 9.x. Unlike breaks #4 and #5, which were measured on main after the release gate had already refused a version-packages PR, this one is recorded BEFORE its three PRs land, so it must land with them: if a release publishes 15.0.x while main still carries the 14.0.0 API, the major is spent on nothing and these breaks then need offset 7. Also riding the pending 15.0.0 major that break #6 records, appended rather than raising the offset again (#4611): the RTC detector no longer takes a caller-supplied job list, because the sample window was the caller's schedule and each pipeline had a different one, so one file resolved to several anchors. ifc-lite-geometry removes `GeometryRouter::detect_rtc_offset_from_jobs` and `GeometryRouter::detect_rtc_offset_with_fallback`; the whole-file `detect_rtc_offset_for_file` is now the only verdict entry point, and the new `detect_rtc_anchor_for_file` is its no-fallback twin for the streaming ladder. ifc-lite-processing's `stream_meta::resolve_stream_meta` loses its `jobs` parameter for the same reason; the `stream_meta::Job` type alias it existed for goes with it (a type-alias removal cargo-semver-checks does not lint; read from the removed item); and `stream_meta::MetaMode::StreamingPartial` becomes a struct variant carrying `scanned_through`, the byte the caller's partial index reaches, so the streaming ladder samples the scanned head instead of decoding the rest of the file to watch every entity in it abstain. Measured with cargo-semver-checks 0.50.0 on this branch, `--baseline-version 14.0.0 --release-type minor` so the baseline is the registry crate and the run discriminates rather than skipping: ifc-lite-geometry 196 checks, 195 pass, 1 fail, 58 skip, `inherent_method_missing` naming three methods, of which `detect_rtc_offset_from_first_element` (src/router/rtc_offset.rs:377 in the published 14.0.0) is #4752's, already recorded above, and `detect_rtc_offset_from_jobs` (:392) and `detect_rtc_offset_with_fallback` (:435) are this change's. ifc-lite-processing 196 checks, 190 pass, 6 fail, 58 skip, of which three are #4749's, recorded in break #6 (`constructible_struct_adds_field` on ProcessingResult.frame, `enum_struct_variant_field_added` and `enum_struct_variant_field_missing` on MeshFrame::SiteLocal), and three are this change's: `function_parameter_count_changed` on `resolve_stream_meta`, 6 parameters to 5, plus `enum_unit_variant_changed_kind` and `enum_discriminants_undefined_non_unit_variant` on MetaMode, both from StreamingPartial gaining its field. Both crates report "semver requires new major version". The break cannot be made additive: keeping the job-list entry points alive would keep alive exactly the per-caller window this removes, which is the defect (AGENTS.md anti-cruft: supersede means delete), and `MetaMode` cannot carry the scan position without changing shape. #4752 (merged as 06357376a) recorded the removal of `detect_rtc_offset_from_first_element` and said `detect_rtc_offset_with_fallback` was not its replacement because it took a job list a whole-file caller does not have; that stays true, and the method itself is now gone for the same reason.
latestBreak: Rust-only break #7: the 15.1.0 crates are published, and #4988 for #3914 adds the public constructible PlaneTag plus Mesh.plane_tags. cargo-semver-checks 0.50.0 reports that ifc-lite-geometry requires a major rather than the 15.1.1 patch carried by this release. The field preserves the exact-kernel f64 supporting plane across the f32 mesh boundary so consolidation can repair a torn coplanar seam without globally merging legitimately distinct near-coplanar faces; removing it would reintroduce the pinned boolean tear. Raises the cumulative offset from 6 so the Rust crates publish at 16.1.1 while npm remains 9.1.1.
